independent_review.text:
# Independent review: render replay repair

The harness-only patch SHA-256 `9d8274dc3fa4c36afe79e5ba64545e736e8c4b05d95386a3bf2ec2b4b2681462` is supported within its source-replay scope. Qualification SHA-256 `8801fb5bc4afac8a4b0c75a6371100e1d36147ef2cb42b106719da0547260418` and all listed evidence members rehashed; the seven recorded owned source images and both tested probe files match. The patch applies cleanly to the current canonical checkout at review time.

The autocomplete probe extracts the owned `hiddenPanePointerState` declaration and supplies actual RxJS `share`, then exercises the owned replayed methods against an explicit style/overlay protocol. Its baseline missing-share and intermediate missing-WeakMap failures are retained. New checks exercise restoring the previous inline pointer value and priority, and reject absent `share` and absent owned map. These are protocol-backed tests, not browser or real legacy component tests.

The select probe extracts the owned `_MatSelectReactiveMixinBase` declaration, and supplies Angular's public `signal` and CDK's public `coerceBooleanProperty`. It verifies signal identity and true/empty-string/false-string/null inputs; the deliberately wrong `!!value` coercion is rejected. The mixed trait parent, DOM and overlay services remain explicit protocols; constructors and members are replayed after decorators are stripped.

Independently reran both modified probes under pinned Node 24.21.0 with NODE_PATH unset and NODE_OPTIONS empty. Autocomplete passed 10 subjects and 16 existing mutation rejections; select passed 10 subjects and 48 mutation rejections, including wrong coercion in eight current-line combinations. The tests themselves assert the new per-subject pointer/map/share and reactive checks. No packed consumer, browser, real legacy node DI, floor, coordinator, security, or G11 qualification follows from this result.
